requirements.general_text: Any of These: A relevant first or second-class Honours degree or a degree qualification. An equivalent qualification recognised by the Malaysian Government, acceptable to the University. Work Experience Requirement: At least two years' appropriate business experience. English Language Requirements: For Non-Native English Speakers: Evidence of English language ability is required. Minimum IELTS 6.0 (or equivalent) with no score lower than 5.5. English Language Courses: Offered for those who do not meet the IELTS 6.0 requirement.
